build_SparseVggNet: build a VGG-style sparse convolutional network with submanifold convolutions and configurable layers
create_SparseResNet: create a pre-activated ResNet with basic residual blocks for sparse convolutional data
build_UNet: build a U-Net style sparse convolutional network with VGG or ResNet-style blocks and downsampling
build_FullyConvolutionalNet: build a fully-convolutional sparse network with VGG or ResNet-style blocks for voxel-level prediction
build_FullConvolutionalNetIntegratedLine: build a fully-convolutional sparse network with integrated linear classification layer
